metadata.description:
The Assam government is helping a private company to grab the land of tribals and small farmers. Azure Solar power has taken over land from tribals using pressure tactics, as well as illegal means. Even the administration is misinterpreting laws to help the power company, instead of the poor tribals and farmers. Here we speak to Vasundhara Jairaith, IIT Guwahati, who has extensively written on the issue.
